sense.text:
This is the split. When the king hearkened not unto them, the people answered, “What portion have we in David? neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: to your tents, O Israel.” Here the twelve tribes divided. Three parts stayed in Jerusalem, Judah, Benjamin and Levi, and they make up the southern kingdom, the so-called blacks. The northern kingdom separated, because they felt they had more right to King David than Judah.

That northern kingdom is the so-called Latinos. To understand how they ended up on this side of the earth, in the Americas, and mainly Latin America, the history has to start here, at the split. There are twelve tribes, and all twelve are needed to get up out of this captivity; that is why the division between the so-called foundational black Americans and the so-called Latinos has to stop. We are all brothers of the same nation.
“In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah began Hoshea the son of Elah to reign in Samaria over Israel nine years.” Hoshea was the king of the northern kingdom, reigning in Samaria.
“And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord”: that evil was idolatry.

“In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria, and carried Israel away into Assyria”: the king of Assyria carried the northern kingdom away captive, “and placed them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.” He displaced them and removed them from their lands.

And to this day we are still displaced from our lands, in Puerto Rico, in Colombia, in Venezuela. That is why there are great migrations, people crossing borders and the Darien Gap trying to get to America. We are displaced because we are under curses and under persecution. These are the signs that let you know who the twelve tribes of Israel are. Nobody can say the northern kingdom, the so-called Latinos, are not Israelites: we are under the same curses.

“Those are the ten tribes, which were carried away prisoners out of their own land”: the northern kingdom, ten parts, carried away captive out of Samaria “in the time of Osea the king, whom Salmanasar the king of Assyria led away captive, and he carried them over the waters, and so came they into another land.” That is exactly what 2 Kings 17 just showed. The history in the Apocrypha lines up with the Old Testament; it is the same Bible. That captivity under Salmanasar was about 722 BC.

“But they took this counsel among themselves”: now it is about 539 BC, under the Persians. Cyrus was enlightened that the Most High had given him all the kingdoms of the earth, he saw the prophecy about him in the scriptures, and he gave Israel liberty to go back to Jerusalem. That is the only reason they were even able to take counsel. They could not do it in Assyria, and Nebuchadnezzar showed no mercy in Babylon.

But the ten tribes decided “that they would leave the multitude of the heathen”. They did not want to be among the heathen anymore; they were tired of captivity after captivity, as it is to this day. So they would “go forth into a further country, where never mankind dwelt”. What is America known as? The new found land. This is how the Dominicans and the Puerto Ricans first came to this side of the world. So it is a lie that Christopher Columbus discovered America.
“That they might there keep their statutes, which they never kept in their own land.” They wanted to keep God's commandments; they wanted repentance and salvation.

“And they entered into Euphrates by the narrow places of the river.” Here the scriptures describe the voyage, how we got here. It was not across the Bering Strait; that is a damn lie. Stop falling for the story that we were always here: this land was not populated until the northern kingdom of Israel traveled here.

“For the most High then shewed signs for them, and held still the flood, till they were passed over.” The route on the map runs from the Euphrates, out of the Assyrian captivity, down around the coast of Africa to its southern tip, and from there to South America. Those waters roar and are known to wreck ships, so the Most High had to hold still the flood.

“For through that country there was a great way to go, namely, of a year and a half”: it was a great way from one side of the earth to the other, and the scripture says plainly how long the voyage took.

“And the same region is called Arsareth.” This side of the earth, Latin America, was called Arsareth. Even the so-called Jewish scholars, in the Jewish Encyclopedia, define it as the land beyond the great river, far from the habitation of man, where the ten tribes would dwell keeping the laws of Moses until the restoration, citing this very chapter. Columbus identified America with that land. Columbus knew where he was trying to get to, because he read the book of Esdras.

Their own historians agree. Columbus found natives with their own language and traditions on Hispaniola, today the Dominican Republic and Haiti, and writers as early as the sixteenth century reasoned that the natives were descendants of the ten tribes. They wrote that the Israelites driven out by Salmanasar wandered into uninhabited regions, which is what this chapter says. They claim the route was the Bering Strait, but nobody crosses icelands where people cannot even survive.

A Portuguese Jew who voyaged to South America in 1641 met a native near Quito in Ecuador who was an Israelite, and was taken to a whole community living in the hinterland, reciting in Hebrew, Hear, O Israel. That is the tribe of Asher in Ecuador. He carried the report back to Manasseh ben Israel. They like to call it a theory, but it is a fact: the Israelites populated and founded the Americas, Abya Yala. Lord Kingsborough, an Edomite, went broke and died in debtors' prison trying to publish the proof that the Mexican Indians were descendants of the lost tribes. They know who we are, but they don't want to say it, because when the so-called blacks, Latinos and Native Americans wake up and realize they are the Israelites, it is a problem for the other nations. Esau needs us hidden to stay on top. These names, Latino, Puerto Rican, are bywords to confuse us, divide us and keep us docile.

“And they shall be upon thee for a sign”: they are the curses, upon us, the Israelites. A sign is how you know where you are, and these curses are the sign to know who we are in these last days. Our history, our language and our heritage were stolen from us, and the way to get them back is to read the scriptures and pay attention to the signs.

“And for a wonder”: so that we wonder, and bethink ourselves. “And upon thy seed for ever”: the judgments of God go round like a ring, a circle, until we get it right, until Christ returns.

“Because thou servedst not the Lord thy God with joyfulness, and with gladness of heart, for the abundance of all things”. The Most High gave us lands and riches; the earth was made for our sakes. But because we chose to be like the other nations, he took it all away, and he is still taking it away.

“Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee”. Those enemies are the ones encroaching on our lands, stealing our lands, poisoning the water and stopping the water in Puerto Rico, because they want what God gave us. The Lord sent the so-called white man against us, from Christopher Columbus until this day. The scriptures say those people are our enemies; they mean us no good.

“In hunger, and in thirst”: we have to go to the enemy for food and for water. Look at Puerto Rico: we have to beg, protest and die just for water that God gave us from the earth and the heavens. “And in nakedness”: for the clothes on our back. “And in want of all things”: even for our own history we have to read their books.

“And he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.” That yoke was captivity and slavery. Now the chains are no longer needed on our necks because they are on our minds: we see the so-called white man as God. He forced us to worship him, and the image Abuelita has in the living room, the bedroom and on the refrigerator door is Cesare Borgia, painted as Jesus Christ during the Renaissance: the image of the beast, not Jesus Christ.

precepts.why:
Before the sign of verse 46 can be understood, the reason for the curses has to be laid down slowly, because this is the morning class for new brothers and sisters. “But it shall come to pass, if thou wilt not hearken unto the voice of the Lord thy God”: if the Israelites would not hearken, “to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command thee this day; that all these curses shall come upon thee, and overtake thee”.

These curses came upon us and overtook us here in the new found land, Abya Yala, the Americas, as it is to this day. That is the “they” of verse 46: the curses are the sign of who we are.

sense.text:
Abelardo de la Espriella, the new president of Colombia, is a so-called Colombian with American citizenship, a far-right Trump supporter and a lawyer who defended drug traffickers, now claiming to wage war on them. How does a man who defended drug traffickers all of a sudden wage war on them? It makes no sense. Maduro was arrested for so-called drug trafficking, and Noriega in the nineties, but the drugs never stop in our lands and our communities. It is a farce, a lie to keep deceiving the people and do what they want with our land and our resources. America needs drugs to import and export, and this is their guy in Colombia, put in where there was a socialist president, Gustavo Petro, who was for the indigenous people of the land.

The scripture shows who he is: “ungodly persons, who hated their own people”. He hates his own people; he would rather have power and wealth, and see his people destroyed for his own gain.

They “went unto the king”: he went unto Donald Trump, “and told him that Jonathan besieged the tower”. He ratted on his people, turned on them and betrayed them. It is the same thing over and over: there will always be traitors among our people. The bombings he began just days after taking office fall on the indigenous and Afro-descendant people of Colombia, the Israelites, the real people of the land, because under that land are oil, gold and lithium that Esau needs for his kingdom. It is not a war on drugs; it is a war on the people.

After seeing our people in Venezuela doing idolatry and witchcraft, and the Most High shaking the land under them, the scripture shows it has always been so: “they left all the commandments of the Lord their God”. That is what our people did. They “made them molten images”, false gods, “and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served Baal”: they served Satan, the devil.

It is not only the tribe of Levi, the so-called Haitians, in witchcraft. The northern kingdom is in that same mess. The plagues keep following us because we do not learn.

“And they caused their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire”: they sacrificed their children, what is called abortion today, which is murder. They “used divination and enchantments”, witchcraft, “and sold themselves to do evil in the sight of the Lord”, because the Most High sees all, “to provoke him to anger.” That is what was on the screen: they sold themselves to do evil.
“Therefore the Lord was very angry with Israel, and removed them out of his sight: there was none left but the tribe of Judah only.” So our people were always into idolatry.

precepts.why:
“Ephraim is joined to idols: let him alone.” Ephraim, the northern kingdom, is joined to idols, so the Lord says leave him alone. That is Santería, brujería and Catholicism among our people today, down to the skull placed inside the idol in Rome.

And the Most High is not leaving it unpunished: the 7.4 earthquake in western Colombia brought down the front of a church that had stood for who knows how long. It took the Most High's fierce anger against our people to destroy it.

sense.text:
Why are they burning the earth in Colombia? Not for chaos, for control. “And they covet fields”: they want our lands; they want to be the landlords. “And take them by violence”: by any means necessary, by fires, by earthquakes, by murder and deception, by making laws and setting up puppet presidents. As Malcolm X said, revolutions are based on land, the landless against the landlord.

“And houses, and take them away”: this is why we migrate and get displaced, because our lands are burned and taken for the minerals under them. “So they oppress a man and his house”, an Israelite man and where he is from, “even a man and his heritage.” These lands were given to us by God.

The Israeli soldiers who came to Colombia under the guise of earthquake relief brought tanks instead of help, and wildfires broke out behind them; they took selfies over people under the rubble and insulted Colombians who carried the Palestinian flag. They are colonizers with cameras: they come to humiliate, to steal and to erase.

precepts.why:
“Even a man and his heritage”: the heritage is the earth itself. “All this have I spoken before thee, O Lord, because thou madest the world for our sakes”. For whose sake? Not everybody's: our sakes, Israel's.

The enemy knows it. Esau knows the world was made for our sake, so he has to make laws to remove us and set up puppet presidents. Israeli nationals get free visas into Ecuador, Peru and Guatemala and are allowed to buy up property, while the people of the land jump through hoops just to keep the lot they have. In Argentina the president changed the laws so that foreigners, who could not buy land before, can now buy it, and the state of Israel is buying up acres at cheap prices.

sense.text: Right after pro-Israel presidents took office in Colombia and Peru, earthquakes struck right over the copper, silver, zinc and bismuth they are after. It cannot be proven that they caused it with bombs or special equipment, but what can be proven is that everything done on the earth is of the Most High. “I form the light, and create darkness: I make peace, and create evil: I the Lord do all these things.” All these earthquakes and all these puppet presidents set in office are there because the Most High allows it.

precepts.why:
Why are these puppet presidents always in our faces, and why can't we get rid of them? “This matter is by the decree of the watchers, and the demand by the word of the holy ones: to the intent that the living may know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men”. The Most High sets these rulers up, “and giveth it to whomsoever he will, and setteth up over it the basest of men”, the lowest of men.

So everything is of the Lord: the earthquakes, the puppet presidents, the evil on this earth. It is all to bring us back to repentance and to the remembrance of who we are in the last days.

“Shall a trumpet be blown in the city, and the people not be afraid?” The trumpet is blown to warn the people. When the Israelites in the four corners of the earth preach God's word, wake up, repent and come to your true nationality.

“Shall there be evil in a city, and the Lord hath not done it?” The Most High has done this evil upon our people, because, as in Venezuela, they are into witchcraft. Not only Haiti: the northern kingdom, the so-called Latinos, are in the same madness, so the Most High brings evil upon the earth to clear the land.

“Surely the Lord God will do nothing, but he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets.” The secrets are the prophecies in this Bible, and we are here to warn the people not to continue in their wicked ways. This is a last-minute land grab and grab of resources before Christ returns; they know they have but a little while. But it is all of the Lord, and he is speeding things up. Israel, get ready.

sense.text:
The United States State Department is pushing evangelical and Zionist religion on the indigenous peoples of the Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta in Colombia, the tribe of Asher, the same thing Christopher Columbus did when he came with that cross: remove all history and remembrance of who we are. “And he had power to give life unto the image of the beast”: he is Esau, the so-called white man, who got his power from Satan. That is what they want for the indigenous people of Colombia and all Latin America: to worship Esau, to give up their culture and language and assimilate.

Why? Because Esau is getting ready to move into those countries. That is why they get visas and buy lands and resources: they know the prophecies that the land of Israel will be attacked by Ishmael and suffer a great destruction, so they are making land grabs to get out of there. “As many as would not worship the image of the beast should be killed”: a lot of indigenous people are being killed and it is not in the mainstream media. So we have to go to the local news of those countries and report it. We are the voice of the voiceless, and it cannot be only the bishops, the deacons and Judah teaching: the northern kingdom has a great responsibility to teach our people that there are more similarities than division between the so-called blacks and Latinos. We are the same under the same curses.

It has been done before. A missionary group, the Summer Institute of Linguistics, financed by the oil companies, would go in where oil lay under indigenous lands, lace the people's food with laxatives, then come with medicine that quickly cured it and say God had sent them, and convince the people to move onto missionary reservations and sign their lands over to the oil companies. When Jaime Roldós of Ecuador, a president for the people, threw them out, the CIA took him out. From the 1950s to the 1980s the CIA and the American government subsidized Pentecostal and Protestant missions in Latin America to dilute the Catholic presence and keep the people from waking up. The Pope works with the CIA too. All your churches are used as weapons against you, so get out of them: their goal is to steal and to indoctrinate.

“And he causeth all, both small and great”: small countries and great countries, “rich and poor, free and bond, to receive a mark in their right hand, or in their foreheads”. Delcy Rodríguez, who succeeded Maduro in Venezuela, demanded her president back, but it looks like she took the deal and the mark. We do not know what is going on behind the scenes, whether she did it to save her people from further destruction; being a leader is a big responsibility, and sometimes a leader has to make decisions for the benefit of the people.
“And that no man might buy or sell, save he that had the mark”: no one buys or sells unless they take that mark. That is what is going on in Colombia, Venezuela and Peru.

Ecuador's government has let US soldiers and contractors in without a visa, even when they are not on security operations, including in Esmeraldas, where our Afro-descendant brothers and sisters live. When they say drug-trafficking gangs, it is really our people, the indigenous and the Afro-descendants, that the war is against, over the minerals in the land. Nobody ships drugs on little boats: it moves by the containerful, and Esau wants all of it.

“He transgresseth by wine”: he, Esau, transgresses by lies and deceit. “He is a proud man”: he thinks the earth belongs to him, when the scripture says the world was made for Israel's sake. He “neither keepeth at home”: he goes free into Colombia, Venezuela and Ecuador with no visa and no permit, to steal the land. He “enlargeth his desire as hell”: wherever he goes it turns to hell for our people, and we end up in prison; the war on drugs and on narco-terrorism is against our people while he controls the drug routes and the mineral routes. He “is as death, and cannot be satisfied”: death to everything he touches, the wildfires, the tanks, the stolen land.

He “gathereth unto him all nations, and heapeth unto him all people”. He is doing that as of late: there was a lot of segregation in the United States until the civil rights movement of the sixties, when we started integrating with this devil, and in London you see a lot of race mixing, East Indians and Chinese, Moab. The seventh beast and the eighth beast, they all do it.

He destabilizes our countries until we cannot grow crops or drink the water, and then says come to America: a nine to five, welfare, Section 8, processed meat. We fall for the crumbs off the master's table. But in Babylon it is still hell: the projects, cashing a check, buying liquor and drugs. Real freedom is your own land and resources, governing yourselves without fear of the enemy.

Real freedom is having no fear, and that means no fear of death. Northern kingdom, a lot of you were in gangs and took penitentiary chances with your lives. Now that you know this truth, die for something: for your people, for their freedom, for the laws of God, and you get the kingdom for that death, not for a corner or a gang. We are God's chosen people, put on this earth to rule.

“The thief cometh not, but for to steal”: the thief is Esau. He does not come with humanitarian aid; he comes with tanks, bombs and fire, to steal the precious resources, “and to kill”, the indigenous people, the Afro-descendants, the Israelites, “and to destroy.” We have seen it in all these videos. So change the algorithm: stop watching funny videos and sports, and watch what is happening to our people in Latin America, in Africa and in the four corners of the earth under the same curses. Watch as well as pray, and pray for deliverance and destruction upon our enemies.

“I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.” Christ came that we might have real life, because the life we live in captivity is not life at all. Christ died for our sins so that this devil can stop ruling over us, and we have to see him for who he is.

The rigged elections in Latin America, with bot farms and fake accounts run by a far-right operative tied to drug trafficking, put in puppets like the ones smiling beside Donald Trump. That is why there is so much uproar in Latin America: the people know they did not elect them. “Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?” They frame mischief by a law: Israeli citizens need no visa for Colombia and can buy land without being nationals. Javier Milei passed a law, and then suddenly forest fires were destroying Patagonia, where Argentina's precious water is.

“They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous”: the righteous are the Israelites, the so-called blacks, Latinos and Native Americans, “and condemn the innocent blood.” They call us drug traffickers and say we cannot prove the land is ours, even though the indigenous have been on it since the beginning, and they take it.

precepts.why:
The mischief framed by a law is the unrighteous decree. “Woe unto them that decree unrighteous decrees”: woe is destruction upon those who make unrighteous laws against the people, for the destruction of the people and the land. When they pull the precious minerals out of the earth the tectonic plates move and earthquakes happen; those minerals are in the earth for a reason. “And that write grievousness which they have prescribed”: they prescribe evil upon our people.

“To turn aside the needy from judgment”: they move our people out of the way, and if you will not move for the decree they come with force. First they send the economic hitman; if you do not take the deal they send the jackals; if the jackals cannot take you out, they send the US military. “And to take away the right from the poor of my people”, the rightful owners of the land and the country, “that widows may be their prey, and that they may rob the fatherless!” They kill the widows, take children from their parents, rob us, the fatherless, of our lands, displace and terrorize us. All of it is by design.

In Chocó, Colombia's most Afro-Colombian department, at the epicenter of the earthquake, the new president promised help and none came; his arrival was even staged, with the people told to raise their hands and make noise. It is all a show while our people suffer the curses.

sense.text:
Puerto Rico is in a water crisis while a two-billion-dollar resort is approved, and the governor, Jennifer González, raises her hand before the delegates and raises money for her reelection while riot police meet the protesters. “Because ye have said, We have made a covenant with death, and with hell are we at agreement”: that is what Jennifer González, De la Espriella and all these puppet presidents have done, a deal with death, with Satan. She is in agreement with whatever they want to do with the island.

“When the overflowing scourge shall pass through, it shall not come unto us”: they think that if they make a deal with Satan it might hit their people but it will not hit them. That is a selfish mentality. “For we have made lies our refuge, and under falsehood have we hid ourselves”: under the false American dream. So have all our people who agree with whatever the US government does in Latin America, Africa, Europe and the Caribbean.

The Zionist Israelis in our lands dress in civilian clothes, but they are military, Mossad, setting the fires and causing the mayhem, and the people are rising up and telling them to get out. “And by their secret plots, and popular persuasions”: they rig elections, “and commotions”: uproars, mayhem and confusion in our countries. While the confusion goes on they rob the land, take the resources and change the laws to allow it.

“They hindered the finishing of the building”: they hinder us coming together as the twelve tribes. That is why they divide and subdivide us into titles, Latino and black, telling us we speak different languages and are not the same. The building is the building of Christ, the church of Christ, which is the twelve tribes of the nation of Israel.

precepts.why: The secret plots of 1 Esdras are the secret counsel David prays to be hidden from: “Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked; from the insurrection of the workers of iniquity”. They work evil, they work sin. When they come into a land, all kinds of evil come with them: prostitution, and a black market full of slaves.

sense.text: “And the merchants of the earth shall weep and mourn over her; for no man buyeth their merchandise any more”. That is what these puppet presidents do not understand: America is geared for destruction. This last-minute land grab only shows what they are trying to prevent, and they are actually speeding up their own demise.
“The merchandise of gold, and silver, and precious stones”: that is all they are after, the precious resources, “and of brass, and iron, and marble”. These are the resources.

“And cinnamon, and odours, and ointments, and frankincense, and wine, and oil, and fine flour, and wheat”: everything needed to sustain life, “and beasts, and sheep, and horses, and chariots, and slaves, and souls of men.” That is what they are after, all through Latin America and the world. Esau is at the forefront, but Ammon and Ishmael are in it too: all the heathen nations are after our lands and resources and leave us destitute. It has been going on since the 1400s.

In Argentina police fake being hit by a car and drag the driver out with a foot on his neck, just like George Floyd and just like ICE does with our people here: they criminalize us and label us terrorists and drug dealers while they steal our lands. The people are not going down without a fight, but the fight is not with guns, rocks or force. It is with the word of the Most High and keeping God's commandments. That is our weapon.

All these things are happening to get the people ready for repentance. “I will go and return to my place, till they acknowledge their offence”: the Most High wants us to acknowledge the sins we have committed, “and seek my face”, by reading the scriptures and keeping the commandments. “In their affliction they will seek me early”: only in affliction are our people ready to hear this word.

So it is preparing us to go out and teach, and when they repent we have to be ready to receive them. Watch the news, not just sports and entertainment, so you can bring it out in your teaching: Peruvians, Ecuadorians, Guatemalans and Mexicans are coming to the camp with questions, and they have to be answered from the scriptures, who they are and why this is happening. They did not come to the United States for the American dream; it was the nightmare, for repentance, so they could see the Israelites teaching in the streets and, if it be the Lord's will, bring it back to their native lands.

In Latin America politics is big: people think the next president is their savior who will solve all their problems. But all these heads of state are set up for their own pockets. And where is the church while all these injustices go on? Making deals.

“The heads thereof judge for reward”: the politicians are there for money and riches. “And the priests thereof teach for hire”: all these fake pastors, Cash Luna, the Dominican with the big BBL, and the rest, set up for money and their own gain. “And the prophets thereof divine for money: yet will they lean upon the Lord, and say, Is not the Lord among us?” They use the Lord and the Bible to put all of you to sleep. “None evil can come upon us”: they make you feel blessed, while in reality they rob the people and get rich.

In Argentina the people are fighting the police with rocks over Milei selling Patagonia to the Zionists; they have had enough. But we have to be ready to pick up the pieces when they ask why there is no justice and no relief. This is for the northern kingdom, the so-called Latinos: it is your turn.

“Who will rise up for me against the evildoers?” The Most High is asking. Not rising up with rocks and fighting: vengeance is the Lord's. Rise up with the word of God, warning the people of the destruction to come, teaching them God's commandments, how to heal, repair and prepare. “Or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?”

The Most High is looking for the northern kingdom to go into Latin America. The bishop does not speak Spanish, and besides Deacon Joshua the deacons do not either. Until we get the Holy Spirit to speak in tongues, you bilingual and trilingual brothers have a job to do, using the gifts of the Most High for his purpose: to wake up the twelve tribes. Look at Naphtali in Papua New Guinea, hungry for the word in great numbers, and the hours the people sat listening in Guatemala. Imagine when the so-called Latinos wake up like that. We have to prepare ourselves.

In Colombia an Israeli military spokesman in uniform stands in a church beside an evangelist, being blessed, while in Gaza, Lebanon and Yemen his people destroy Ishmael. What is military attire for in God's house? “The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart”. That is why destruction comes when you let him into your lands, and why Argentina, Puerto Rico and Peru are protesting while the puppet governments sic the military on our people.

The spokesman accused of covering up the genocide now leads rescue efforts in Colombia. They are not rescuing anything; they are land grabbing, preparing the land for their own people, because they know they are not safe in Israel anymore. That is why they go to Patagonia, the fertile lands with the water and the minerals.

They are rocking the people to sleep. “Measure thou the time diligently in itself”: we measure the time by the events going on in this world, by watching the news. “And when thou seest part of the signs past, which I have told thee before”: wars and rumors of wars, earthquakes in divers places.

“Then shalt thou understand, that it is the very same time, wherein the Highest will begin to visit the world which he made.” The Most High is visiting the world with destruction, but it is all for the repentance of God's people, the Israelites, the so-called blacks, Latinos and Native Americans.
“Therefore when there shall be seen earthquakes and uproars of the people in the world”: earthquakes in Venezuela, in Colombia, in Peru; uproars in Argentina and all over Latin America.

“Then shalt thou well understand”: now we understand why these things are happening, and we have to show the people it is no coincidence. These things happen because God wants us to repent. “The most High spake of those things from the days that were before thee, even from the beginning. For like as all that is made in the world hath a beginning and an end, and the end is manifest”.

“And every one that shall be saved, and shall be able to escape by his works, and by faith”. How do we escape this destruction and this evil? By works: keeping God's commandments and going out to teach your people repentance and their nationality. And by faith: faith in the real Christ. The Christ of the Bible was a black man, just like the people suffering in Latin America and in Africa.

All these things have to happen for the repentance of our people. So you so-called Latinos, northern kingdom of Israel, it is high time to awake out of sleep. Get out of that sports mentality and music mentality: we are bigger than that, and we have to repent.
